component.name: Dream Player
component.summary: Offline music player with sync between devices
Плеер офлайн-музыки с синхронизацией между устройствами

description.p: A GTK 4 desktop frontend for the rs_dream_player core: playlists, a play queue, tag and cover editing, import / export of .dplr packets, sync with other devices (TCP, USB through adb), core mods, MPRIS. This project is created entirely with AI.
